# Bunoraa

> Bunoraa is a Bangladeshi marketplace for hand-embroidered fashion, home decor, and artisan-crafted products, connecting customers with ethically sourced, traditionally embroidered clothing and home essentials.

Bunoraa works with local Bangladeshi artisans to preserve traditional embroidery techniques including nakshi kantha. Products are made from natural-fiber cotton and hand-embroidered. The site serves customers across Bangladesh with delivery to all districts. Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT, ৳).

## Products

- [Women's Collection](https://bunoraa.com/women/): Hand-embroidered shalwar kameez, co-ord sets, and kurtis with floral and geometric patterns
- [Kids' Collection](https://bunoraa.com/kids/): Girls' frocks, button-down dresses, and co-ord sets with vibrant hand-embroidered designs
- [Home Decor](https://bunoraa.com/home-decor/): Embroidered cotton cushion covers and artisan home essentials
- [All Products](https://bunoraa.com/products/): Complete product catalog across all categories

## Featured Products

- [Ivory Blossom Hand-Embroidered Cotton Co-ord Set](https://bunoraa.com/women/co-ord-sets/ivory-blossom-hand-embroidered-cotton-co-ord-set/): Ivory white co-ord set with multicolor floral embroidery and magenta pants. Breathable cotton, suitable for Eid and festive occasions
- [Petite Noir Hand-Embroidered Cotton Dress](https://bunoraa.com/kids/girls-frocks-outfits/petite-noir-hand-embroidered-cotton-dress/): Jet black girls' dress with red and orange hand-embroidered floral motifs. Cotton, available in multiple sizes
- [The Enchanted Meadow Hand-Embroidered Cotton Cushion Cover](https://bunoraa.com/home-decor/cushion-covers/the-enchanted-meadow-hand-embroidered-cotton-cushion-cover/): Premium off-white slub cotton cushion cover with asymmetrical hand-embroidered bouquet of blue delphiniums
- [Ivory Garden Hand-Embroidered Cotton Button-Down Dress](https://bunoraa.com/kids/girls-frocks-outfits/ivory-garden-hand-embroidered-cotton-button-down-dress/): Ivory white girls' dress with multicolor floral hand embroidery and button-down front
